claim_ceiling: This file is a case register and test-to-case traceability index. Rust unit tests listed here are synthetic reference tests, not independently adjudicated benchmark outcomes, vendor comparisons, SAWEM operator verification or investment-performance results. Cases marked not_run have no measured result. The DSU price-curve unit tests remain synthetic price-lookup conformance, not evidence of DSU product admission, reserve qualification, settlement or revenue. DSU qualifying-capacity tests cover only the named synthetic Code arithmetic branches; they do not authenticate source records, implement utilized-service alternatives, calculate performance-adjusted payments or establish market qualification. Reserve-capacity payment tests are exact formula checks over synthetic or prequalified inputs; they do not establish reserve-category prices, real qualifying capacity, operator performance factors, market admission, settlement or received cash. DSU capacity-path tests distinguish utilized, changed-instruction and unchanged-instruction cases and apply the effective-availability ceiling; acceptable-performance decisions are still supplied as prequalified inputs. The reserve payment formula rejects a reserve-category price labeled for a different reserve product. The constrained-schedule oracle integrates a synthetic piecewise-constant curve over signed schedule values with explicit Trading Period duration; it is not a Market Operator settlement reproduction and does not authenticate schedules, price submissions or market statements. The credit-cover increment computes only source-calendar-backed deadlines and notice timeliness; it does not calculate Actual Exposure, Undefined Potential Exposure, UEF, Required Credit Cover, collateral sufficiency or project liquidity. Credit-cover exposure arithmetic counts unpaid invoices and uninvoiced Settlement Statement amounts without double counting, but accepts Undefined Potential Exposure as an externally supplied value and does not calculate the Market Operator UEF or annual Required Credit Cover parameters. Remediation only counts receipt-backed early invoice payments and collateral posted by the explicit deadline; it does not model bank-provider creditworthiness or guarantee cash availability. Credit-cover remediation validates unique receipt references and source-digested civil-date coverage; it still does not authenticate the real bank/Market Operator source or model provider creditworthiness. Funding-option economics are simple-interest scenario calculations using externally supplied participant funding cost and Collateral Reserve Account yield. They compare only the two paths listed in §15.10.2(3); they do not prove bank or account eligibility, live availability of funds, actual interest credited, or optimal investment funding. Rev 2.3's acceptable Credit Cover form is a cash-held deposit in a Collateral Reserve Account; generic bank guarantees and letters of credit are not modeled as permitted alternatives. undefined The credit-cover amount calculation is a synthetic sum of exposure components and supplied UPE, not the MO's full §15.10.3 Actual Supplier Exposure / UEF result. New deadline coverage includes provider replacement within ten Business Days and advance notice of Posted Credit Cover changes one Business Day beforehand. Liquidity stress snapshots distinguish externally supplied MO Required Credit Cover and Posted Credit Cover from treasury cash headroom. Potentially fundable cover is not posted cover and assumes no transfer or MO acceptance until separately evidenced. The module does not calculate UEF, post collateral, predict cash availability, or infer the timing of payment-system transfer. The liquidity waterfall is a dated scenario projection with committed, forecast and adverse-stress paths. It does not authenticate forecast receipts, prove bank transferability/cash availability, increase Posted Credit Cover for planned deposits, or establish the Market Operator's Required Credit Cover beyond source-bound inputs. Forecast-vintage replay reconstructs only synthetic/prequalified records available by a frozen decision time. It is not a forecasting model, market price feed, source-authentication mechanism or evidence of improved forecast accuracy; rolling-origin calibration and live/historical backtests remain not_run. Forecast calibration scoring is an exact-accumulator implementation over synthetic/prequalified forecasts and realized observations. It does not establish feed authenticity, model calibration on real market data, predictive superiority, forecast value capture or comparative performance; rolling-origin, project/time holdout and vendor baselines remain not_run. Execution-fidelity metrics compare synthetic signed scheduled energy with synthetic meter/settlement records. They do not prove actual asset performance or calculate SAWEM imbalance settlement; the public M5BAT field dataset and a source-frozen replay remain to be acquired and independently reproduced. The BMS capability evaluator is a SOC-only, synthetic/ source-qualified curve interpreter. No M5BAT field curves have been fitted, and temperature, SOH, cell voltage, imbalance and dynamic BMS state are not modelled; operational qualification and power-delivery improvement are not demonstrated. The revenue-realization bridge is an evidence-attribution kernel tested on synthetic signed adjustments. It does not forecast prices, calculate SAWEM settlement, validate the completeness of source systems or establish that its category allocation is causally unique. Any unclassified/unobserved difference remains an explicit residual; no empirical realization factor or revenue improvement has been measured. The multidimensional capability-surface evaluator validates and selects precomputed cell limits; it does not fit limits from raw telemetry, establish electrochemical safety, or grant operational authorization. No field surface has yet been fitted or validated. Non-anticipativity validation checks equality of submitted scenario actions under shared information sets. It is not a stochastic optimizer, policy-quality benchmark or evidence of lower regret until candidate policies are compared on a common out-of-sample scenario tree. The BMS cell fitter computes an exact empirical lower order statistic from prequalified synthetic/source-bound observations. It does not authenticate source telemetry, fit the full surface, estimate a confidence bound, guarantee the physical power limit between samples or establish safety; field calibration and holdout validation remain not_run. Warranty compliance is evaluated only against the exact supplied warranty schedule and explicit throughput accounting basis; it does not estimate state-of-health fade, infer OEM exclusions, predict remaining useful life or establish the warranty claim outcome. SOC rainflow counts are source-bound cycle descriptors under an explicitly named three-point variant. They are not degradation, equivalent-life, warranty-damage or remaining-useful-life outputs; those require validated OEM/chemistry-specific cycle and calendar degradation functions. Cash-risk metrics compute exact expected net cash, loss probability and lower-tail VaR/CVaR from externally supplied scenario outcomes and probabilities. They do not estimate or calibrate the scenario distribution, establish project bankability, or predict realized cash. The decision-regret evaluator scores submitted scenario outcomes and audits shared-information actions. Its perfect-information oracle is a non-implementable upper bound under declared matched constraints; EVPI is not forecast error, policy regret against an optimal implementable policy, or measured improvement. Scenario probabilities, source records and policy/oracle results are prequalified inputs; calibration and real-market comparison remain not_run. The paired-policy evaluator compares two submitted implementable policy outcome sets and verifies identical scenario, rule, physical, network, settlement and information-frontier bases. It does not execute vendor software, verify vendor feature entitlements, establish data authenticity or prove superiority; external adapter execution and independent field results remain not_run. Source-clock conversion maps only explicitly declared offsets to UTC and exposes differing instants for equal wall-clock labels. The M5BAT schedule/measurement one-hour difference remains unresolved until raw archive and publication-level time alignment are independently reconciled; no field schedule fulfilment claim is made.

cases.title: Leakage-free as-of forecast vintage reconstruction
cases.scenario: For each price/forecast target period and model identity, reconstruct only the forecast vintages and realized observations that were available to the decision workflow at the frozen decision timestamp. Select the latest eligible forecast by issue time, let a realized observation supersede only after the target interval ended and the observation became available, exclude future-known records, report missing coverage, and reject ambiguous latest vintages. Forecast issue time, target valid time and source available-at time are separate. A target without a model identity must not silently choose among different forecasting engines; the caller must explicitly scope the target by model. Source availability is distinct from issue time: a forecast issued before decision time but published after the decision is excluded. A known realized observation is model-independent, so it may supersede competing forecast engines without requiring a model identity. Model scope is the pair of immutable model label and exact model SHA-256; builds sharing a label but not a digest are separate forecasting engines.

target Trading Period start and end timestamps
forecast model identity and executable/model content digest

cases.title: Leakage-free probabilistic forecast calibration and scoring
cases.scenario: For one exact immutable forecasting model build, score quantile predictions against realized Trading Period prices that were available by the evaluation timestamp. Compute median MAE, signed bias, squared-error sum, q10/q50/q90 pinball loss, empirical quantile coverage, central-80% interval coverage and exact weighted interval score. Quantile crossing, future-known forecast/actual data, mixed model builds and duplicate target periods are rejected.

cases.title: Evidence-bound schedule-to-meter execution fidelity
cases.scenario: Compare signed scheduled export/import energy against signed meter energy over a frozen horizon. Report schedule, meter and settlement time coverage separately; absolute deviation, unfulfilled scheduled energy and overdelivery; and fulfilment only when the full schedule horizon is covered by meter evidence. Reconcile actual booked balancing charges only when source-bound settlement evidence exists for every interval. Future-known meter/settlement records, duplicate record IDs, overlapping intervals and schedule revisions published after delivery start are rejected. Intervals must be ordered by start timestamp, then must not overlap. A schedule revision published after delivery start and a meter observation before the interval has ended are invalid; settlement evidence cannot exist without matching meter evidence. Meter and settlement source references are unique across intervals, even when record IDs differ.

signed metered grid energy for the matching delivery interval

This is a bounded SOC-only envelope; temperature, SOH, cell voltage, imbalance and dynamic BMS state remain separate future dimensions.

cases.title: Evidence-attributed bridge from theoretical revenue to realized net cash
cases.scenario: Reconcile theoretical gross revenue to realized net cash using source-bound signed adjustments for forecast regret, availability, execution deviation, balancing settlement, market fees, degradation/warranty, financing/collateral and contract/curtailment effects. The caller declares which categories are required for the asset/contract. If any required category is absent, the bridge remains incomplete, only partial reconstructed net is reported, and the unexplained residual/realization ratio are withheld. Future-known evidence, invalid source hashes and duplicate component IDs are rejected. This decomposes effects that aggregate revenue realization haircuts combine. One source receipt cannot back two adjustment components under different component IDs.

cases.title: SOC-temperature-SOH conservative capability surface
cases.scenario: Evaluate charge/discharge power against a complete, source-bound cell grid indexed by SOC, temperature and SOH. Every cell must have a unique source reference/digest and, for field-measured evidence, a declared lower-quantile rule and minimum sample count. Boundaries are deterministic half-open cells with the final endpoint included. The evaluator performs no interpolation or extrapolation; incomplete grids, duplicate coordinates/source refs, insufficient samples, malformed axes and out-of-range states fail closed. Synthetic cells may be used for scenario exploration but cannot be represented as a non-synthetic evidence basis.

cases.title: Scenario policy non-anticipativity and information-set action audit
cases.scenario: For every decision timestamp and shared information node, all scenario paths with identical source-digested information set and availability frontier must submit exactly the same net-power, reserve-up, reserve-down and target-SOC action. Actions may diverge only after their information nodes have diverged. Information availability after the decision timestamp, inconsistent information-set digests/availability times, duplicate scenario decisions, undeclared scenario IDs, invalid SOC targets and different actions before the information split fail closed. This audits a submitted policy; it does not solve a stochastic optimization problem. Empty decision sets and declared scenario paths with no actions are incomplete and cannot pass.

cases.title: Deterministic lower-quantile fitting for BMS capability cells
cases.scenario: Fit one SOC × temperature × SOH × direction cell from source-bound BMS-reported available-power telemetry or explicit capability-limit tests. Ordinary delivered power is rejected because it is censored by the dispatch request. Every measurement must belong to the declared calibration campaign and condition cell, have unique record/source identity, valid digest and availability no later than the calibration as-of time. A declared lower empirical quantile uses the exact zero-based rank floor(q × (n−1)); the cell requires a minimum sample count. The selected order statistic and source record are returned, but the caller must freeze the complete sample manifest and bind its digest before using the result in a capability surface.
required_evidence: frozen calibration campaign ID and as-of timestamp
per-observation source ref, SHA-256, observed-at and available-at timestamps
SOC, temperature, SOH and charge/discharge direction for each sample
BMS-reported available-power telemetry or explicit capability-limit test evidence
rated AC-side power and unit identity
declared lower-quantile basis-point parameter and minimum samples per cell
separately hashed canonical sample manifest for each resulting surface cell
holdout validation campaign that is excluded from cell fitting

cases.title: Source-traceable ASTM E1049 three-point SOC rainflow counting
cases.scenario: Extract SOC reversals from time-ordered BMS samples, apply the named ASTM E1049-style three-point method, preserve each counted half/full cycle's original sample indexes and timestamps, and report full/half cycle counts, equivalent-full-cycle half-units, depth-weighted count units and maximum depth. A source-bound maximum sample gap splits the history into separate segments; no cycle is inferred across a gap and the trace is marked incomplete. The method identifier is explicit, because ASTM E1049 recognises multiple counting methods and does not recommend one method. The evaluator does not map cycles to capacity fade, warranty damage or remaining life.
required_evidence: raw SOC time series with original sample IDs and source content digests
UTC sample timestamps, observed-at and available-at timestamps
BMS source/channel identity and unit declaration
explicit maximum admissible sample-gap policy and its source digest
named rainflow method and residue convention
coverage, gap and segment report
OEM/chemistry-specific depth-of-discharge degradation curve before any damage or life calculation

cases.title: Probability-weighted project cash downside and lower-tail CVaR
cases.scenario: For a frozen set of source-bound project cash outcomes and explicit scenario probabilities, compute expected net cash, the probability of negative net cash, worst-case cash, lower-tail VaR and lower-tail CVaR using exact basis-point probability arithmetic. Probabilities must have been available by the evaluation time and sum exactly to 100%. The lower-tail CVaR includes partial probability mass at the quantile boundary. This evaluator does not estimate probabilities or establish that a supplied scenario distribution is calibrated.
required_evidence: project/portfolio identifier and evaluation as-of timestamp
scenario identifiers and mutually exclusive outcome definition
net project cash outcome per scenario after explicitly declared costs
scenario probability source, version and available-at timestamp
exact probability allocation summing to 100%
common financing, settlement, tax and lifecycle assumptions across scenarios
tail probability definition and currency/unit declaration

cases.title: Matched-information non-anticipative decision regret and EVPI
cases.scenario: Evaluate a forecast-informed dispatch policy whose actions are identical across scenarios sharing the same decision-time information set. Compare its probability-weighted net cash with a separately reported perfect-information oracle under the same market-rule, asset-constraint, network-topology and settlement basis. Report expected regret / value of perfect information, worst-case regret and upper-tail VaR/CVaR. Scenario probabilities must be available at every policy decision time, sum exactly to 100%, and all outcome/result evidence must be available by evaluation time. The clairvoyant oracle is a mathematical upper bound, not an implementable policy and not a forecast-error measure.
required_evidence: declared scenario IDs and a source-bound scenario outcome for every scenario
probability manifest, source digest and availability timestamp
scenario-specific implementable-policy net-cash outcome and source receipt
scenario-specific perfect-information result under the same scenario and constraints
frozen market-rule profile and digest
frozen asset-constraint and usable-energy basis
frozen network topology / point-of-connection basis
frozen settlement and revenue/cost basis
scenario decision logs with information-node IDs, information-set digests and action values
decision-time and information-availability timestamps for every scenario action
evaluation as-of timestamp and upper-tail regret probability definition

cases.title: Matched, paired comparison of two implementable non-anticipative policies
cases.scenario: Compare a candidate BESS dispatch policy with an implementable baseline/vendor policy on the exact same declared scenarios, probability manifest, source-bound market-rule profile, asset constraints, network topology and settlement basis. Both policies must be non-anticipative and must have identical decision coverage and information-node IDs, source digests and available-at timestamps at every decision time. Report expected candidate-minus-comparator net cash, probability of each policy winning or tying, worst/best paired delta and lower-tail VaR/CVaR. The evaluator scores submitted outcomes; it does not run either policy or establish external-vendor superiority.
required_evidence: distinct candidate policy identity and immutable model/build SHA-256
distinct comparator/vendor policy identity and immutable model/build SHA-256
shared declared scenario IDs and immutable scenario-manifest source/digest
scenario probability manifest and available-at timestamp
candidate and comparator decision logs with common information-node IDs and information-set digests
candidate and comparator decision timestamps and source-availability frontiers
paired candidate/comparator net-cash outcomes with unique result record IDs and source digests
identical market-rule version and digest
identical asset constraints, ratings and usable-energy basis
identical network topology/point-of-connection basis
identical settlement, tariff, balancing and revenue/cost basis
evaluation as-of timestamp and lower-tail delta probability

cases.title: Source-specific civil time mapping and schedule/measurement clock reconciliation
cases.scenario: Map each raw source civil timestamp to UTC using an explicit source-bound signed offset and content digest. Never infer timezone or DST from host settings or a label. Compare equal civil wall-clock values under independently declared source offsets and report the resulting UTC delta without applying an automatic correction. The M5BAT supplemental documentation declares schedule timestamp UTC+1 and measurement timestamp UTC+2; equal wall-clock labels therefore map to UTC instants one hour apart, and source-to-source alignment remains unresolved until the original CSV contents and the paper's intended mapping are inspected.
required_evidence: original schedule and measurement CSVs preserved byte-for-byte
archive SHA-256 and per-member SHA-256 digests
source-document evidence for schedule UTC offset
source-document evidence for measurement UTC offset
timezone/DST interpretation or per-record UTC offset mapping
raw timestamp strings and exact parser/format version
explicit source clock IDs and mapping receipt
independent schedule-to-measurement alignment validation
